Welcome to Fircroft Primary School!
We have tours of the school on most Thursday mornings starting at 0930. They are usually led by our Head Teacher, Mrs York and run for approximately 45-60 minutes.
Please contact our attendance officer, Jos Bernard, to book a school tour and meet our confident, creative community.
